codes.evidence_quote: el cante —nuestro signo de ser pueblo-raíz o cumbre de una expresión antigua
codes.target: el cante de Fosforito / cante flamenco
codes.rationale: The poem grounds the value of the cante in collective rootedness, origins, and an ancient expressive continuity.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The poem uses aesthetic language such as 'hondo' and 'grito', but it is too metaphorical to function clearly as a criterion-based evaluation.

derived_analysis.target: el cante de Fosforito / cante flamenco

annotation_notes: Poetic text; coded only where roots/origin language clearly authorizes the cante.

codes.evidence_quote: barajábamos los términos de las bases: pureza, profesionalidad, constancia, nuevos matices cantaores, labor de difusión del cante
codes.target: Fosforito as recipient of the Compás del Cante
codes.rationale: The passage explicitly lists aesthetic and professional criteria used to judge flamenco value.

codes.evidence_quote: el jurado que otorga la distinción del «Compás del cante»... Fosforito era su ganador por práctica unanimidad de los aficionados
codes.target: jury and aficionados conferring the Compás del Cante
codes.rationale: A jury and group of aficionados are positioned as authorized evaluators who confer recognition through a critical award.

codes.evidence_quote: el jurado, que acertó plenamente; la entidad organizadora, que se prestigió más si cabe en su noble empeño a favor de nuestro arte
codes.target: the award decision in favor of Fosforito
codes.rationale: The author explicitly evaluates the award decision as correct and valuable for flamenco.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The award is institutional, but the passage frames it mainly as critical recognition rather than heritage authorization.

derived_analysis.target: Fosforito and the Compás del Cante award

codes.evidence_quote: se ha convertido andando el tiempo en el maestro flamenco, en el nuevo maestro del cante andaluz... hacen de Fosforito la figura actual
codes.rationale: The quoted assessment canonizes Fosforito as the current central master and figure of cante.

codes.evidence_quote: fuente donde tiene que beber el que quiera permanecer puro
codes.target: Fosforito as source for pure flamenco
codes.rationale: The passage uses purity language to make Fosforito a source for maintaining legitimate flamenco purity.

codes.evidence_quote: Dotado de un prodigioso sentido musical, jamás comete un fallo
codes.rationale: Musical sense and faultless execution are applied as criteria of artistic quality.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The mention of a family in flamenco for several generations suggests lineage, but the visible quote does not clearly frame transmission as authorizing knowledge.

annotation_notes: The article compiles quotations; codes are based only on visible quoted judgments.

codes.evidence_quote: Ese cante es cante grande, puro y jondo por derecho... Cante de verdad
codes.rationale: The poem explicitly presents the cante as true, pure, and properly jondo, authorizing it as genuine flamenco.

codes.evidence_quote: Tiene voz de tribu errante, raíces, sonidos negros, duendes sueltos por la sangre
codes.rationale: The passage invokes roots, black sounds, and duende as aesthetic markers of flamenco depth and quality.

codes.evidence_quote: Tú, Córdoba, has marcado un nuevo hito porque has reconocido con decoro el arte de tu hijo, «Fosforito»
codes.rationale: The poem frames civic recognition by Córdoba as a public act that valorizes Fosforito's art.

annotation_notes: Although poetic, the authenticity and civic-recognition claims are explicit enough to code.

codes.evidence_quote: Después del maestro está el gran vacío (en cierto modo lógico), después, los demás.
codes.rationale: The passage constructs a sharp hierarchy with Mairena above all others in the flamenco field.

codes.evidence_quote: no todo el trigo está tan limpio como pretende aparentar... a muchos «se les ve el plumero» de la vanidad, el afán de protagonismo
codes.rationale: The author uses critical discourse to police the boundary between sincere homage and self-serving public display.

codes.evidence_quote: El gran maestro en todos los cantes Antonio Mairena, a estas alturas no es un artista criticable ni discutible.
codes.rationale: The passage explicitly evaluates Mairena's artistic status as beyond criticism or dispute.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The word 'Maestro' is used as an honorific for artistic status, not as evidence of teaching or pedagogical authority in the visible text.
